remove_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x502 -DWINVER=0x502)

add_definitions(
    -D__WINESRC__
    -D__ROS_LONG64__
    -D_WIN32_WINNT=0x0600
    -DWINVER=0x0600)

spec2def(dxva2.dll dxva2.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# dxva2.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/dxva2-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(dxva2_shims OBJECT main.c)
target_link_libraries(dxva2_shims PRIVATE wine uuid libole32 libuser32 libkernel32_vista libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module(dxva2_shims)
add_dependencies(dxva2_shims wineheaders psdk)
add_cargo_module(dxva2 dxva2-cargo dxva2.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS dxva2_shims psdk uuid_sources)
